mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard (run by make lint) fails on a stale ratchet entry for a function no longer above 100 lines. Proceed and ExecuteTransitionsReportWith are now orchestration over private steps (proceedRun.preflight/commit/execute; transitionPass.readInputs, collect, fenceDirectCoding, recordCycles, executeSorted, snapshotBaseCommit, planChildren, afterCommit), their two keys and the proceed.go file key are removed from area_a4_test.go (proceed.go is 634 lines, transition_pass.go 607) and the guard passes. Negative proof: re-adding the Proceed key made TestS1SizeGuard fail with 'stale ratchet entry internal/ops/proceed.go:Proceed ... no longer above the 100-line limit', and it was removed again.

The cycle (TestEAT_CycleDetection_*), recovery-through-pass (TestEAT_CrashRecoveryThroughEAT), topological ordering, handoff admission and failure (plan_handoff_failure_test.go, d63_auto_resume_test.go), cohort classification (TestExecuteAvailableTransitionsReport_CohortClassification) and base-commit (TestExecuteAvailableTransitions_SnapshotsGoalBaseCommit) white-box tests run unchanged against the moved code. Negative proofs, each restored: skipping the transition_cycle_blocked event failed TestEAT_CycleDetection_* and oracle cycle_blocked; dropping the many-to-one cohort wait from the non-failure classification failed TestExecuteAvailableTransitionsReport_CohortClassification/live_member_is_a_normal_wait; disabling the base-commit snapshot failed TestExecuteAvailableTransitions_SnapshotsGoalBaseCommit and oracle coding_base_commit; clearing the pass-start stamp failed TestD63ResumeStampsPlanningAttempt; admitting every gated hand-off failed TestD63SkippedPlanningPassDoesNotStamp/held and oracle reviewed_skip.

TestOracleTransitionPass adds five state goldens (partial_pass, cycle_blocked, reviewed_skip, recovery_pass, coding_base_commit) rendered through a report helper that prints results, failures and warnings. They were committed in af2d86535, an oracle-only commit that precedes every production edit and was generated from the unchanged production tree; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a4 reproduces them and every older A4 golden, which are untouched. partial_pass pins that a refused plan (unresolvable selective inheritance) is reported while the other plan's children commit; note the refused plan is not byte-unchanged, it records the material hand-off failure observation, which the golden freezes. cycle_blocked uses testdata/fixtures/defects because a dependency cycle is an invalid state that the validated fixture catalogue must not contain.

TestTransitionPassTriggerFilter asserts the models trigger constants spell auto/manual and that the string trigger filter selects only auto, only manual, or both (manual then auto) for the empty filter. availableTransitions and needsGeneration compare the filter with string(models.TransitionTriggerAuto/Manual), the replanned markers in the pass use models.ReplannedTransition, and the integration fallback is the named constant defaultIntegrationBranch (value unchanged; no owner constant existed outside init_project.go, which is outside scope). The coding-pair base-commit check stays a configured identity as written. Negative proof: making the auto filter return manual transitions failed TestTransitionPassTriggerFilter, TestExecuteAvailableTransitions_AutoTransition and oracle TestOracleAutoTransitions, and was restored.

TestOracleProceed, TestOracleProceedExpansion, TestOracleAutoTransitions and the A3/A5 oracles that expand transitions run live against their unchanged goldens, as do the new TestOracleTransitionPass goldens, under make test.

TestEveryRatchetKeyIsInTheSnapshotOnceAndPlacedInOneArea and TestS1SizeGuard (make lint) pass with the Proceed, ExecuteTransitionsReportWith and proceed.go file keys removed from area_a4_test.go; the moved ordering helpers (topoSortPending, findSCCs and the rest) are each within the 100-line limit in transition_pass.go.
